result:
Phase 3 is done and frozen, with the tests failing for behavioural reasons. Every acceptance criterion and edge case has a test, but no test has ever passed against working behaviour. All were written against the skeleton before any story was built. I wrote the UI selectors from the wireframes, not from a running UI, so some of them may need an approved change once screens exist. Nothing was run on Firefox or WebKit.

## What was written
- **Backend acceptance:** 326 tests across 21 classes, in `backend/src/test/java/app/contactgroups/acceptance/`. They run the whole backend in-process on a throwaway PostgreSQL and go over HTTP with unsigned emulator tokens and a clock the tests can move. The class for a 10,001-contact group counts as 4 of these tests but reports as one error because its shared set-up fails.
- **Browser acceptance:** 96 Playwright tests in `frontend/acceptance/`. They run against the real Compose stack and find elements by role, label or text from the wireframes.
- **End-to-end:** 8 tests in `frontend/e2e/`, one per scenario E2E-01 to E2E-08.
- **Coverage:** all 363 acceptance criteria and edge cases have a test by name.
- **Hidden suite:** 251 cases in `hidden-tests/` (216 backend, 35 browser) covering all 226 rules and shared rules. I ran it once; the report is `hidden-tests/report/junit.xml`.

## First run on the skeleton
| Suite | Tests | Failed |
|---|---|---|
| Backend acceptance | 326 | 326 |
| Browser acceptance + e2e (Chromium) | 104 | 104 |
| Hidden | 251 | 251 |

Most backend failures stop at the first call of the scene, `POST /groups`, which answers 500 because the endpoint does not exist. The rest stop at missing screens or fields. The skeleton already satisfied three tests, so I strengthened them to need the screens that are still missing: AC-018-01, EX-017-01 and EX-017-09. The first-run table with one reason line per group is in `docs/03_test-strategy.md`.

## Things to know
- **Contract copy:** `backend/src/test/resources/acceptance/openapi.yaml` is a copy of the contract (614 lines, over the 400-line commit limit). The tests need it inside the backend folder, because the Maven image only mounts that folder.
- **Commit mistake:** the move of `shell.spec.ts` from `e2e/` to `checks/` was staged earlier and landed in commit `884425b`, which is labelled `docs:`. History is not rewritten, so it stays and is noted in the handover.
- **Unconfirmed readings:** the field name of an error is checked only where the specification fixes it. A group in Trash answers 404 to its Owner (decision D-17). Two Owners deleting at once give one 204 and a 404 or 409. These are listed in the strategy file.
- **Browser stand-ins:** two browser rules use stand-ins. A fixed History time is set by answering the request with a fixed time. The 10,000-contact export limit is shown with a stubbed refusal, and the real limit is tested through the API.
- **Formatting:** the hidden suite was formatted with Prettier defaults (double quotes) because `hidden-tests/` has no config of its own.

The freeze commit is `80361bc`, containing only the two manifests. Next command is `/implement US-001`, nothing is waiting for the human, and the handover is `docs/00_progress.md`.
